'''Port shadowing''' was a tactic used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] to stay one step ahead of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]]. The tactic called for the pirates to avoid any legal [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and only dock at fringe ports, free worlds, or [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]]. Port shadowing was expensive, as these ports usually charged a premium for their services and were way above that of the free market. Also, it limited the pirates since there was usually only one or two shadowports operating within a [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="PP" />
